title: SCTV: The Greatest Show You've Never Heard Of
original_title: SCTV: The Greatest Show You've Never Heard Of
plot_overview: Through intimate interviews and an emotional reunion in Toronto, this documentary looks back at a small Canadian television production and the creative partnership behind it. Its surviving cast members reflect on how the show grew into a cultural phenomenon and helped launch celebrated comedy careers.
will_you_like_this: You may enjoy this if you’re interested in comedy history, creative partnerships, and reunions with longtime cast members; Not for you if you’re looking for a fictional story or detailed reviews.
review_summary: Pros: intimate interviews; emotional reunion; comedy history | Cons: no critical details; no viewer reactions
